usage: tr slo [-h] [--session SESSION]
              [--inject-delay-minutes INJECT_DELAY_MINUTES] [--window WINDOW]
              [--budget-usd BUDGET_USD]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION     an NYSE session (default: the latest one tr daily ran
                        for)
  --inject-delay-minutes INJECT_DELAY_MINUTES
                        add this many minutes to the measured finish, to
                        exercise the breach path
  --window WINDOW       sessions looked back for misses (default 10)
  --budget-usd BUDGET_USD
                        the cost target for the session's first paid run
                        (default 0.60)
